offering_description.value: Operates an online insurance marketplace that connects consumers shopping for insurance with insurance carriers and agents. It generates quote requests and leads through its website, app and marketing, and sells them to carriers and agents, mainly for auto insurance.

primary_services.value: online insurance comparison marketplace; lead generation for insurers; customer referrals to insurance agents; data and analytics for carriers

customer_segment.value: B2B: insurance carriers and independent insurance agents buying leads and customer referrals; B2C: consumers comparing and shopping for auto, home, renters, life and health insurance

end_markets.value: insurance (auto, home and renters, life, health); consumer insurance shopping

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: carriers pay per click, lead, call or referral, and for customer policy sales; commissions or management fees: commissions from carriers on policies sold through its agency channel
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs a digital marketplace taking in consumer quote requests and selling them to carriers and agents; financial intermediary: licensed agency selling policies for carriers

geography_served.value: US national: consumers and insurance carriers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: auto, home and renters, life and health insurance marketplaces, mainly auto

distribution_channels.value: online: website and mobile app, with online marketing to attract consumers; direct sales: sales to insurance carriers and agent partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: insurance producer licensing and state insurance regulators, plus consumer privacy and telemarketing rules like TCPA

notes: The commission revenue from its agency channel is a small and uncertain part of the business.
